questions.question: What name does Isaiah 29 give to Jerusalem?
What does the LORD say about this people's worship in Isaiah 29?
options: Their offerings are pure and ever pleasing in the sight of the LORD
They have forsaken the temple and bow to the idols of wood
They draw near with their mouths but their hearts are far from him
Their prayers rise like sweet incense before the throne of God
questions.answer: They draw near with their mouths but their hearts are far from him

questions.question: Isaiah 29 compares the people's spiritual blindness to a sealed book that none can read.
This people draw near with their mouth and honor me with their lips, while their _____ is far from me.
In that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book, and out of their gloom the eyes of the _____ shall see.
